Overview

Bogra is a city in Rangpur with a population of 400,000. A historic city in northern Bangladesh known for its archaeological sites, including the Mahasthangarh ruins. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.0.
